At BlackSky, we’re more than a workplace.

Together, we’re

make an impact on a global scale .
What we offer
Competitive compensation
We offer competitive compensation as well as 401(k) with employer match.
100% health insurance
We cover 100% of our employee’s health premiums for medical, dental and vision insurance with various plan choices such as HRA, LSA and HSA.
Time off
Flexible work schedule
Need to focus on family certain hours of the day? Are you a night owl? We can work with you to build a schedule that works best for you and your teammates.
Maternity leave
New birth mothers receive up to eight weeks of paid leave for medical recovery due to childbirth, supplementing employer-provided disability insurance.
Parental leave
For births or adoptions, new parents are offered paid leave to care for and bond with their new child.
ESPP
Be part of the growth and success story at BlackSky by participating in our Employee Stock Purchase Program.
PC or Mac
You select the type of computing environment that works best for you. And, yes, we are deeply into cloud computing.
Casual offices
No stuffy environment at BlackSky. We want you for who you are, not what you wear.
On-site perks
Like to work out at lunch? Visit our on-site gyms. And recharge afterwards with free snacks and beverages.
Team get-togethers
We host events across teams. Learn who your coworkers are, not just where they sit and what they do.
Unique swag
Lots of companies offer embroidered hats and gear (and we do, too). But, which of them offer mission patches too?
Our promise
People first
You will enjoy a wide range of benefits and perks designed to help you achieve personal, professional and financial growth. Ours is an environment of both opportunity and progress.
Work-life balance
Our work is fast-paced and at times demanding, but our goal is to always strive for balance and to support our people to be well-rounded, healthy individuals—not just BlackSky employees.
Epic culture
Employees all contribute to and are a part of a culture that helps us show up at our best. We are strongly committed to diversity, inclusion and making sure all voices are both represented and heard.

The Foundry

The Foundry
Our Story
Radian One
Company
Investors
Contact
The advanced materials we manufacture today let us fly tomorrow.
Scroll
The Platform
The Foundry.
A digital-first manufacturing system, built to industrialize extreme-temperature materials at scale.
The end-to-end advanced-materials platform that the next generation of aerospace, defense, energy, and industrial systems needs now.
Foundry 1, the first facility, is in development, with more facilities to follow as the platform scales.
The Bottleneck
Advanced systems are being designed around materials the industrial base cannot yet produce economically.
The most ambitious next-generation aerospace and defense systems are not limited by performance. They are limited by the economics of producing advanced ceramic composites at scale.
Radian is building the scalable manufacturing platform to change that.
Demystifying the Technology
Ceramic Matrix Composites.
CMCs combine ceramic heat resistance with composite strength and low weight, reshaping high-performance systems. The advanced composites market is converging around one critical material.
70%
Lighter than advanced superalloys.
300°C
Higher maximum operating temperature.
You already rely on ceramic composites. The same family of materials turns up wherever heat, speed, and reuse meet:
Jet engine hot sections
Turbine shrouds and blades that run hotter and lighter, for more thrust and better fuel burn.
High-performance car brakes
Carbon-ceramic discs that take repeated extreme heat without fading and last far longer than steel.
Rocket nozzles and re-entry shields
Surfaces that survive re-entry-grade temperatures and can fly again.
The ambition of modern engineering has outpaced the economics of manufacturing.
“Ceramic matrix composites are poised to be the next material revolution… Analogous to carbon fiber reinforced composites in the mid-80s, CMCs are poised for explosive growth.”
Dr. David E. Glass, Senior Technologist, Applied Materials for Space and Hypersonics, NASA Langley Research Center
Source: NASA conference presentation, 2024
The Solution
A digital-first manufacturing system, built to industrialize CMCs at scale.
An independent, automated, end to end CMC production line, open to every customer.
Purpose-built to improve yield, increase cadence, and structurally compress cost. Fabrication, thermal processing, finishing, quality control, and digital process control
one integrated platform. This is how scalable CMC production becomes a national capability.
Integrated Production Chain
Preform fabrication, densification, and inspection engineered as one coordinated system, not siloed steps.
AI and Robotic Automation from Day One
Robotics, controlled fiber placement, and programmable high-temperature processing designed to systematically reduce variability, scrap, and manual intervention.
Digital Production Layer
Process modeling, digital twins, and AI-enabled process control compress cycle time, stabilize throughput, and structurally lower cost to optimize yield.
Foundry 1
integrated production chain
AFP cell 1 Automated fiber placement lays composite onto tooling, replacing hand lay-up.
AFP cell 2 Second preform fabrication cell.
Pyrolysis furnace 1100°C, converts the polymer matrix to ceramic.
Graphitization furnaces 2400°C, densify the CMC to final form.
Digital twin Process modeling and yield optimization across the whole chain.
Hover the markers for each station. Stations in order: preform fabrication (AFP cells 1 and 2), pyrolysis furnace, graphitization furnaces, digital twin.
Every major piece of the Foundry's technology already exists. Radian is integrating it.
Inside the Foundry
The equipment, the process, the physics.
Automated fiber placement cells feed a multi-furnace, high-temperature processing chain that turns composite preforms into finished ceramic-composite parts.
Pyrolysis
Densification
1100°C
0°C
2400°C
Graphitization
High-temperature processing
2400°C

Dur-E-Therm TPS
Radian's proprietary thermal protection system.
Hot-fired at NASA Glenn to ~1,480°C through repeated ascent and re-entry profiles, including two 120-minute hypersonic test runs. Patent pending.
Reusable, not ablative
Designed to survive repeated re-entry without burning away, unlike single-use ablative heat shields.
Beyond shuttle-era
Longer life, a wider operating envelope, and easier operability than legacy thermal protection.
Dual-use by design
One architecture serves re-entry heat shielding, cryogenic tank insulation, and terrestrial high-heat industry.
More on Dur-E-Therm
Testing performed at NASA facilities under Space Act Agreement. Does not imply NASA endorses Radian or its products. Tests were ground simulations of flight profiles.
Cost Economics
~50% reduction in CMC manufacturing cost.
The Foundry is designed to succeed where CMC industrialization has stalled. It targets a ~50% reduction in manufacturing cost by improving three structural drivers of CMC economics.
Driver 1
Preform fabrication cost
Automated fiber placement at production cadence, replacing hand lay-up.
Driver 2
High-temperature cycle-time compression
Furnace infrastructure and process control to compress pyrolysis and graphitization cycles.
Driver 3
Yield stabilization and scrap reduction
Digital twin and integrated quality control across the chain.
Target from Radian's internal cost model for Foundry 1. The Foundry has not yet operated; targets are unproven.
Radian One development cost, as the Foundry scales
Markets We Serve
The Foundry industrializes the materials these systems depend on.
A market forming across four categories, all converging on the same capacity shortage.
Reusable
Re-Entry Systems
Spaceplanes, capsules, upper stages, rocket nozzles.
Hypersonic, Aerospace
Advanced Defense Systems
Glide vehicles, interceptors, structures, advanced propulsion.
Industrial
Energy Systems
Gas turbines, nuclear and hydrogen power and storage.
Thermal Management Systems
Data-center and semiconductor cooling, high-performance braking.
Four markets, one capacity shortage
Reusable
Re-Entry
Hypersonic
Defense
Industrial
Energy
Thermal
Management
Every one of these markets needs the same CMC capacity, and it does not exist at scale today.
Offerings
Services and products.
Services
Manufacturing Services
Process development, qualification, and pilot-scale production for advanced composite structures.
Product Development
Engineering, simulation, and CMC processing for partner programs from concept through qualification.
Advanced Simulation
Materials modeling, process simulation, and digital-twin services across the production chain.
Products
CMC Components
High-temperature CMC parts for aerospace, defense, and industrial use.
Dur-E-Therm TPS
Thermal protection system parts for repeated re-entry without ablation.
Dur-E-Therm Industrial
High-temperature CMC parts for industrial high-heat environments.
Thermoplastics
Thermosets
Advanced composite materials supporting the broader manufacturing chain.
Roadmap
From Foundry 1 to industrial scale.
The Foundry is the business, and it scales first. Over the long term, it also makes Radian One, the spaceplane, possible.
Foundry 1
The first advanced-materials foundry comes online and begins producing high-temperature ceramic composites for customers.
Foundry 2
A second, larger facility brings ceramic-composite manufacturing to full industrial scale.
First flight
Radian One, the spaceplane the Foundry makes possible, takes to the air.
First orbital mission
Routine, on-demand access to orbit, the long-term mission realized.
Where it fits
What we manufacture today lets us fly tomorrow.
The Foundry industrializes extreme-temperature materials for aerospace, defense, and industry. It also makes Radian One affordable to fly.

detonation .
Detonation waves rotate around the engine like an aerodynamic compressor and

burn the fuel.

radically more energy

HYDROGEN ENERGY STORAGE
Own your energy — For the coming seasons.
Energy costs are nearly at their highest, and the technology to get off the grid has never been more accessible. Hyviva pairs your solar array with hydrogen-based energy storage.
Reserve HyvivaGrid
See how it works
This is the age of energy independence.
Millions of people are moving toward a world where they own their energy and the means to store it for coming seasons.
Hyviva gives you freedom from high energy bills, outages, and an outsized carbon footprint.
Introducing HyvivaGrid
A complete home energy storage system: modular high-capacity energy storage with a smart energy hub in one integrated package.
Whole-home energy backup
Works with any solar system
Uses safe metal hydride to store hydrogen
Smart energy management app with real-time insights
Modular capacity that grows with your household
Professional installation and 10-year warranty
HOW IT WORKS
Your solar panel, put to work twice.
Hyviva gives your solar panel something to do when it s just producing unused energy
turning surplus daylight into decades of stored power.
Solar Surplus
Excess energy your panels produce beyond household demand...
Electrolyzer
...is used to split water into hydrogen and oxygen...
Metal Hydride Storage
...then stored in safe and lossless metal hydride with a lifespan of 30+ years.
Fuel Cell
If energy is needed, the fuel cell draws stored hydrogen to generate power on demand...
Home or Business
...and delivers continuous power, independent of the grid.
Engineered for performance and quality
Every system is custom configured to meet the energy demands of its destination
residences and businesses.
With manufacturing hubs across the U.S. and E.U., Hyviva minimizes logistics impact and accelerates deployment while reducing the carbon footprint of global shipping.
THE BENEFITS OF HYDROGEN
Storage that doesn t lose energy.
Hydrogen in metal hydride storage costs less than lithium batteries and holds its energy for more than 30 years - completely lossless.

LITHIUM

lossless

What our customers say.
Private residence

Robert Tordy

Alexandre Rottet

Norbert Nemes, Volta Swiss, Managing Partner and Technical Director
Factory
Heide, Germany
“HyvivaGrid is one of the most innovative energy storage system in the industry, using hydrogen to reduce cost, increase safety, and provide 30 years of lossless energy.”
Ulf Joergensen, CEO of H2 Core Systems
FAQ
Questions, answered.
How is HyvivaGrid different from a battery?
Is storing hydrogen at my home or business safe?
Yes. HyvivaGrid doesn t use high-pressure tanks. The hydrogen is stored in metal hydride, which keeps it stable and unpressurized. There s no risk of thermal runaway fires that can affect batteries.
How long can I store hydrogen energy?
Hours, days, months, or across seasons. Stored hydrogen doesn t discharge over time, so you can save summer surplus for winter, when solar output is lowest.
Does HyvivaGrid make me independent from the grid?
It can. For most people it greatly reduces what they pay the utility and keeps the power on during outages.
How do the economics compare to batteries?
How much energy is lost converting solar to hydrogen and back?
Converting electricity to hydrogen and back uses some energy. We achieve about 60% round trip efficiency. But once stored, the hydrogen loses nothing for decades.
Is HyvivaGrid available where I am, and how do I get started?
HyvivaGrid is currently available in the EU.
